title: Mahou Shoujo Pretty Samy: Heart no Kimochi
native_title: 魔法少女プリティサミー ～ハートのきもち～
overview: Mahou Shoujo Pretty Samy: Heart no Kimochi is a visual novel style adventure game based on the Magical Girl Pretty Sammy anime series. It includes two new original story episodes: the first involves a mysterious group creating a new kind of super-weapon, while the second revolves around the cast preparing chocolates for Valentine's Day. Gameplay is identical to the previous title: voiced dialogue sequences over still images drive the story, and the player is occasionally given a choice of which action to take in a scene; these choices will affect how the rest of the scene plays out but not the overall story progression.
